lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Mg2Ti2O8 (reduced formula Ca2MgTiO4) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Cmcm (No. 63). Its unit cell contains 16 atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies TiO6 octahedra and CaO6 octahedra as the main coordination environments, alongside Mg-centered six-coordinate oxygen environments. Corner-sharing is observed between TiO6 and CaO6 octahedra, and between Mg-centered six-vertex polyhedra and TiO6 octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
